meta.name: animation-vocabulary
meta.description: Reverse-lookup glossary that turns a vague description of a web animation or motion effect into its exact term ("the bouncy thing when a popover opens" → Pop in; "the iOS rubber-band scroll" → Rubber-banding). Use when the user asks "what's it called when…", or describes a motion effect without knowing its name and wants the right word to prompt an AI or designer with. For naming an effect, not designing or building one.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用大白话描述动效,换回能直接使用的准确专业术语
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常看到某个动效却叫不出名字,想用准确术语跟 AI 或设计师描述它。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a vague motion description into the exact term to use
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you see an effect, can't name it, and want the right word to tell an AI or designer.

howto.what: 你描述看到或感觉到的动效(比如"弹出框像从按钮里长出来"),Claude 会从内置词表里给出对应的准确术语:先给最匹配的一个,再列 1~2 个相近词并说明区别。它只负责命名效果,不设计也不实现动画。
howto.when: 当你说"这叫什么"、或用模糊说法描述某个动效却不记得术语名字时触发。它只用来命名效果,不负责设计或实现。

say.text: 弹出框从按钮里长出来,这个效果叫什么?
say.note: 返回对应术语,先给最匹配的一个

say.text: iOS 那种拉过头会回弹的滚动叫什么?
say.note: 给出该效果的准确术语

say.text: 一张图片变成另一张图片,有哪几种叫法?
say.note: 列出术语并说明彼此区别

howto.what_en: Describe a motion effect loosely and Claude returns the exact term from its built-in glossary, best match first plus 1-2 close alternates with notes on how they differ. It names effects only; it does not design or build them.
howto.when_en: Fires when you ask "what's it called when..." or describe a motion effect without knowing its name and want the right word to prompt an AI or designer. Naming only, not designing or building.

say_en.text: What's it called when a popover grows out of the button you clicked?
What's the term for the iOS scroll that resists and snaps back?
One image turning into another — which terms apply?
say_en.note: Lists Morph, Crossfade, Shared element transition
